default.name: Mono
default.description: A sidebar-first minimalist theme, ideal for writers and bloggers. Fixed left navigation, warm off-white palette, and a title-list layout that keeps the focus on content over decoration.
default.author: Synaptik

atrium.name: Atrium
atrium.description: Editorial gallery-grade theme inspired by contemporary art spaces. Generous whitespace, oversized serif typography, curtain page transitions, scroll-driven reveals, a soft custom cursor, and an ink-spread dark/light switcher. Ships with two distinctive page templates: a corporate studio landing and an exhibition program page.
atrium.author: Synaptik

axion.name: Axion
axion.description: An editorial, asymmetric flagship theme with a floating pill navigation, oversized typographic hero, distinctive section layouts for each page template (corporate walkthrough, personal long-form, editorial blog, bento portfolio, split contact), full shortcode and gallery styling, and refined animations.
axion.author: Synaptik

blueish.name: Blueish
blueish.description: A dark navy variation of Darkish Theme — same condensed display typography, same layout, swapped to a deep blue-slate background with orange highlights.
blueish.author: Synaptik

darkish.name: Darkish
darkish.description: A dark theme with a near-black green-tinted background, condensed display headings, contrasted body text, and green highlights throughout.
darkish.author: Synaptik

dispatch.name: Dispatch
dispatch.description: Ultra-minimal single-column blog theme. A thin changelog-style timeline rail marks the latest articles by date on the homepage and archive listings, with a single coral accent and generous whitespace. Ships with Wide and Changelog page templates.
dispatch.author: Synaptik

gazette.name: Gazette
gazette.description: Print-newspaper theme for chronological blogs. Masthead header, full-serif typography with drop caps, and a persistent dated-archive sidebar on every page. Ships with Full Width and Archive page templates.
gazette.author: Synaptik

ink.name: Ink
ink.description: Clean, minimalist editorial theme for writers and bloggers. Light/Dark switch, big type, clean masonry card grid, burger menu, and nothing to distract from the content.
ink.author: Synaptik

linen.name: Linen
linen.description: Warm, handmade-feeling theme for small businesses, artisans and personal blogs. Centered masthead header, true masonry card grid with organic image heights and a gentle tilt, rounded paper-card content view, peach and sage pastel palette. System serif headings, zero external requests.
linen.author: Synaptik

myelin.name: Myelin
myelin.description: An ultra-clean, versatile flagship theme inspired by neural anatomy. Warm neutral palette, refined typography, subtle animations, and dedicated page templates for corporate, personal, blog and portfolio sites. Ships with a sticky dropdown navigation, full shortcode and gallery styling, polished contact form, related content, and custom fields.
myelin.author: Synaptik

natura.name: Natura
natura.description: An earthy, nature-inspired dark theme featuring floating leaf particles, a sticky header with animated botanical decoration and smooth scroll-reveal effects.
natura.author: Synaptik

nova.name: Nova
nova.description: A modern, animated theme featuring a full-screen hero, sticky transparent header with burger navigation, orange and teal accents on a clean white canva.
nova.author: Synaptik

portfolio.name: Portfolio
portfolio.description: A vibrant, animated portfolio theme for artists and creative professionals. Features a bento-grid layout, bold typography, and rich project display.
portfolio.author: Synaptik

prism.name: Prism
prism.description: Vibrant flat-design theme with a 5-color palette, dark/light mode switcher, horizontal article cards, square color-flip project tiles, and clip-path scroll reveals.
prism.author: Synaptik

shebang.name: Shebang
shebang.description: Monospace developer theme: terminal-inspired typography end to end, prompt-style navigation, dashed-border cards, indigo accent. System monospace stack only, automatic light/dark via prefers-color-scheme, no JavaScript required.
shebang.author: Synaptik

slab.name: Slab
slab.description: Neo-brutalist theme: thick black borders, hard offset shadows, no rounded corners, oversized uppercase headings on a cream background with an electric-lime accent. System fonts only, zero external requests, CSS-only mobile nav.
slab.author: Synaptik

sudo.name: Sudo
sudo.description: IDE-inspired developer theme: fixed sidebar file-tree navigation, a file tab bar, a directory-listing home and archive view instead of card grids, and a status bar footer. Monospace throughout, automatic light/dark via prefers-color-scheme, no JavaScript required.
sudo.author: Synaptik

synaptik-docs.name: Synaptik-docs
synaptik-docs.description: A clean, documentation-focused theme with a collapsible sidebar, in-page TOC, light/dark mode toggle, and inline search dropdown. Designed for structured technical content.
synaptik-docs.author: Synaptik

vanta.name: Vanta
vanta.description: A dark editorial theme with bold typography, bright green accent colour, top navigation, dropdown search field and card-based grid layout.
vanta.author: Synaptik

vitae.name: Vitae
vitae.description: CV/portfolio theme with identity card hero, animated skill bars, experience timeline, masonry project grid, dark/light toggle, and styled contact form. All CV data is managed from a single admin page.
vitae.author: Synaptik

analytics.name: Analytics
analytics.description: Lightweight server-side analytics: page views, unique visitors, referrer URLs, traffic sources, device breakdown, and country geolocation — no external scripts, no cookies, GDPR-friendly.
analytics.author: Synaptik

booking.name: Booking
booking.description: Standalone appointment booking module with calendar availability, admin approval workflow, callback requests, ICS calendar invites, and history of past appointments.
booking.author: Synaptik

comments.name: Comments
comments.description: Native comments for articles, pages, and projects, with moderation, one-level replies, and spam protection.
comments.author: Synaptik

cookie-consent.name: Cookie Consent
cookie-consent.description: GDPR-friendly cookie consent banner with per-category opt-in (analytics, marketing), stateless customizable UI, and a public JS API so themes and other plugins can defer their tracking scripts until consent is given.
cookie-consent.author: Synaptik

formbuilder.name: Form Builder
formbuilder.description: Custom form builder with text, dropdown and checkbox fields. Submissions are saved on the server and emailed as a PDF summary to the site contact address.
formbuilder.author: Synaptik

maintenance.name: Maintenance Mode
maintenance.description: Show a maintenance page to visitors while you keep working on the site as a logged-in admin.
maintenance.author: Synaptik

newsletter.name: Newsletter
newsletter.description: Email newsletter signup with double opt-in and a manual article digest sender.
newsletter.author: Synaptik

redirects.name: Redirects
redirects.description: Manual 301/302 URL redirects, plus an optional 404-to-home fallback.
redirects.author: Synaptik

reviews.name: Reviews
reviews.description: Customer reviews with a manual admin-managed list, displayed as a carousel or grid via shortcode.
reviews.author: Synaptik

wp-importer.name: WordPress Importer
wp-importer.description: Import posts, pages, categories, tags and SEO metadata from a WordPress XML export (WXR) file.
wp-importer.author: Synaptik
